name: Our Buildings
summary:
Our Buildings is a Virtual Reality platform designed to help users visualize and experience houses or buildings in a realistic and immersive way, even before they are physically built. Using Meta Quest 2, 3, and 3s, users can enter, walk through, and interact with buildings as if they were real.

Users can manually open doors by grabbing door handles, use physical keys or RFID cards, access automatic doors, and operate fully functional elevators that move users between floors realistically instead of simple
